answer_1.quote: We focus on summarization, question-answering, and dialog-act classification, all from existing SLU datasets.
answer_1.outputs: summaries, extracted answer spans, dialog-act labels

answer_2.quote: We use standard ROUGE metrics and pairwise comparison ... for summarization, fuzzy match, exact match, token-level F1 for QA, and macro-F1 and accuracy for dialog-act classification.

answer_3.quote: Pairwise comparison has been shown to be highly effective for judging the overall quality of summaries using gpt-4-0314 as a judge. We use ... gpt-4o-mini ...
